thread:
anna: Quick all-hands recap — thanks for joining. Main takeaways: Redwood Optimize beta is live for pilot partners, new default short retention for trials, and SLO playbooks kickoff next week. Recording + links below.

diego: recording + slides: https://redwood.cloud/recordings/2134567890-allhands.mp4 and https://drive.redwood/company/allhands/2134567890-slides.pdf

mira: question on retention: does the trial default apply to demo sandboxes? we host some demo orgs for partners.

lucy: short answer: demo sandboxes inherit trial defaults unless explicitly configured. legal/ops posted the policy doc here: https://docs.redwood/company/policies/trial-retention-2026.md

ops_bot: Follow-ups doc created: https://docs.redwood/company/allhands/2134567890-followups (owners assigned).

oliver: product note: Optimize beta includes adaptive batching + KV cache reuse; expect 15-30% token cost improvement depending on workload.

anna: action items: 1) product to share beta onboarding flow (owner @oliver) by Wed; 2) ops/legal to publish retention FAQ (owner @lucy) by Thu; 3) everyone nominate SLO rep by EOD Fri. Add anything else to the follow-ups doc.

mira: thanks 44d tagging partner-eng about demo sandboxes.

anna: appreciate it. we'll post a short blog blurb + social copy once marketing finalizes bullets. If you missed the live Q&A, drop questions in the follow-ups doc or DM me.
